description: If propositional premises \(\Gamma\) do not derive \(A\), some complete consistent closed theory contains \(\Gamma\) and omits \(A\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.consequence_separation.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α)
  (h : ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheoryDerives Γ A) :
  ∃ T,
    Γ ⊆ T ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsClosed T ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsComplete T ∧ A ∉ T
